Har generation ko lagta hai unki parenting best thi—and har nayi generation pichhli wali ko toxic bolti hai. Aaj Indian parents ke around bhi wahi narrative chal raha hai. But the real question is: are we actually moving in the right direction?

In this video, we break down the reality of new age parenting in India. iPad kids, phone addiction, zero physical activity, speech delays, early exposure to harmful internet culture, academic pressure, absentee parents, and the silent mental health crisis among children. At the same time, we also talk about the positives—more aware parents, better understanding of mental health, and freedom in personal choices.

This is not a “parents-bashing” video. It’s an honest conversation about balance—between discipline and freedom, ambition and presence, hustle and emotional availability. Because giving children everything except time might be the biggest mistake we’re making.

Watch till the end before judging—especially if you’re a parent or planning to become one.
